name: Math Runner
tagline: An endless runner with math questions
description: A kid runs down a city street. A math question floats above the track and three answer boards block the lanes: run into the lane with the right answer, and jump or slide past obstacles.
features: Three lanes, a growing speed and streak bonuses.
Coins and power-ups: slow motion, magnet, shield, extra life.
A third-person camera from the Character View constructor.

name: KP Paintball Arena
description: A team 3D shooter on an invented paintball arena in Kamianets-Podilskyi. Pick red or blue and be the first team to score 10 against the bots.
features: First- and third-person camera with a centre-screen aim.
Movement, camera and input come from the engine, not game code.
Bots move between cover with AI Navigation.

name: Temnorid Arena
tagline: Duels of warriors, archers and mages
description: Step into a stone courtyard against five bots and fight with weapons and elemental magic. Every period the best fighter of each class becomes its Hero.
features: Free-for-all for six fighters: two of each class.
Bots on the shared engine AI.
Online play, phone controls and self-updating Windows builds.

name: Temnorid Caravan Guard
tagline: Guard trade caravans on dangerous roads
description: Raiders, steppe riders and wolves wait along the road. Place guards on the route, upgrade the ones that matter and bring the wagons home.
features: Top-down camera from the shared engine package.
Online co-op and phone controls.
Goods that arrive feed trade in Lords.

name: Temnorid Conquest
tagline: Take the village, defeat its Lord
description: Wars for territory and the capture of settlements. Lead the assault on a village in person, fight its guards and its Lord, and defend your own lands.
features: Your own home village.
Playing with others online.
Phone controls and self-updating builds.

name: Temnorid Craft
description: Build up your farmstead, gather wood, stone and ore, and make tools, weapons and armour. What you store joins the same stock you have in Lords.
features: Six resources, a backpack and a village warehouse.
Inventory from the shared engine package.
Shared stock with Lords.

name: Temnorid Detective
description: Grain is missing and the night watchman is dead. Inspect the places, question the villagers, compare what they said with what you found and make your report. A wrong report is a normal ending.
features: Fixed cinematic shots in four zones.
Alone or as two investigators.
First playthrough about 15 to 25 minutes.

name: Temnorid Dungeons
tagline: Clear the ruins, beat the boss, keep the loot
description: Explore dangerous ruins, fight monsters, defeat bosses and find rare treasure and artefacts for your heroes.
features: A compact dungeon with a boss and its warning attacks.
Alone or with up to three friends.
Loot kept in the shared inventory.

name: Temnorid Escape
description: A scout is locked in the cell under the watchtower. No weapons and no combat: read the clues, solve three puzzles, slip past the guard and leave by the service gate.
features: Fixed camera shots per room.
Light co-op for two players.
First playthrough about 10 to 15 minutes.

name: Temnorid Hippodrome
tagline: Ride, race, cross the line first
description: Breed and train horses and bring them to the track. A horse's speed, stamina and temper, together with your sense of pacing, decide who crosses the line first.
features: Its own race camera: a horse is not a walking character.
Races against bot riders.
Multiplayer and saved best times.

name: Temnorid Legends
tagline: Every legend has its own hero
description: A series of separate stories in action, adventure and survival horror. The first demo, The Abandoned Village, takes about 15 to 20 minutes.
features: Shared controls, cameras and combat for every legend.
Each legend has its own plot, mood and ending.
The first demo is built and tested.

name: Temnorid Master
tagline: Learn seven trades in one village workshop
description: A workshop career game: take an order in the stable, scribe, forge, workshop, kitchen, tailor or herbalist trade, do a few hands-on steps and get paid for the quality of your work.
features: Seven trades with one wallet, one level and one save.
A wrong answer is never punished.
Optional co-op for up to four players.
